class.name: CgameSceneCRDT
class.brief_description: Scene document as an operation-based CRDT for multi-user editing.
class.description: [CgameSceneCRDT] keeps a scene tree that several editors can change concurrently and that converges to the same state on every replica regardless of the order in which operations arrive. [b]Model.[/b] Every node has a stable string id. Properties are last-writer-wins registers ordered by (Lamport clock, replica id). Node existence is an add-wins set: every [code]add_node[/code] creates a unique tag and [code]remove_node[/code] only tombstones the tags it has seen, so a concurrent add survives a remove. The child order under each parent is an RGA sequence; every placement (add or move) is an element [code]"lamport@replica"[/code] inserted after a reference element, siblings inserted after the same reference are ordered newest first, and the highest placement of a node wins. [b]Operations[/b] are dictionaries with the keys [code]kind[/code], [code]r[/code] (replica), [code]seq[/code] (per-replica counter) and [code]l[/code] (Lamport clock), plus [code]id[/code] and kind-specific keys. Kinds are [code]add_node[/code] ([code]parent[/code], [code]after[/code], [code]props[/code], [code]type[/code]), [code]remove_node[/code] ([code]tags[/code]), [code]set_prop[/code] ([code]prop[/code], [code]value[/code]) and [code]move_node[/code] ([code]parent[/code], [code]after[/code]). [method apply] is idempotent and commutative. [b]Sync.[/b] Exchange [method state_vector] and answer with [method ops_since]; duplicates are harmless. Presence (cursor and selection) is an ephemeral channel that is not part of the operation log. [codeblock] var a = CgameSceneCRDT.new() a.replica = "alice" var b = CgameSceneCRDT.new() b.replica = "bob" a.local_op("add_node", {"id": "root", "type": "Node3D", "props": {"name": "Root"}}) b.merge_ops(a.ops_since(b.state_vector())) [/codeblock]

method.name: all_node_ids
method.description: Returns the ids of all alive nodes reachable from the top level in depth-first order. Cycles created by concurrent moves are dropped.

method.name: apply
method.description: Applies a local or remote operation. Returns [code]true[/code] if it changed the state and [code]false[/code] for a duplicate.

method.name: apply_presence
method.description: Applies a presence message. Messages older than the newest one already seen from the same user are ignored and [code]false[/code] is returned.

method.name: children_of
method.description: Returns the ids of the alive children of [param parent] in RGA order. Use an empty string for the top level.

method.name: expire_presence
method.description: Removes users that were not heard from since [code]now_msec - ttl_msec[/code] and returns their names.

method.name: from_packed_scene_dict
method.description: Creates a document owned by [param replica] and fills it from a nested scene dictionary. See [method load_scene_dict].

method.name: get_prop
method.description: Returns the value of the register [param prop] of [param node_id], or [param default] if it is not set. The value stays readable after the node was removed.

method.name: has_node
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if at least one add-tag of [param node_id] is not tombstoned.

method.name: load_scene_dict
method.description: Fills this (empty) document from a nested dictionary [code]{id, type, name, props, children}[/code]. A missing [code]id[/code] becomes the path of the node, for example [code]"Root/Child"[/code].

method.name: local_op
method.description: Builds, applies and returns a local operation and emits [signal op_generated]. [param args] always has [code]id[/code]. For [code]add_node[/code] it may have [code]parent[/code], [code]index[/code], [code]type[/code] and [code]props[/code]; for [code]set_prop[/code] [code]prop[/code] and [code]value[/code]; for [code]move_node[/code] [code]parent[/code] and [code]index[/code]. An [code]index[/code] that is negative or past the end appends.

method.name: local_presence
method.description: Records the ephemeral state of the local user and returns the message to broadcast. [param time_msec] is a caller-supplied timestamp used by [method expire_presence].

method.name: merge_ops
method.description: Applies many operations and returns how many were new.

method.name: ops_since
method.description: Returns the operations a peer with the state vector [param vector] may be missing.

method.name: parent_of
method.description: Returns the parent id of [param node_id] according to its winning placement, or an empty string.

method.name: presence
method.description: Returns a copy of the presence of all users as [code]user -> {l, cursor, selection, t}[/code].

method.name: remove_presence
method.description: Removes [param user] from the presence list.

method.name: state_vector
method.description: Returns the highest contiguous sequence number per replica. A gap in the received operations does not advance it.

method.name: to_scene_dict
method.description: Returns the first top-level node as a nested dictionary [code]{id, type, name, props, children}[/code], or an empty dictionary for an empty document.

members.member: Identifier of this replica. It must be unique among all collaborating editors.
The Lamport clock. It advances with every local operation and is raised to the highest clock seen from remote operations.

signal.name: op_generated
signal.description: Emitted for every operation created by [method local_op]. Broadcast it to the other replicas.
